tagline: Offline Torah Notes & Hebrew Handwriting OCR Studio
taglineHebrew: סטודיו אופליין לזיהוי ועריכת כתב יד תורני ומחברות שיעורים
releaseTitle: v1.3.4 — Interactive User Guide & Training Tutorial (F1) and Instant Startup
description: Ohr HaKsav (אור הכתב) v1.3.4 delivers an interactive 5-tab User Guide & System Training Tutorial (F1), a dedicated Help button (❓) on the top toolbar, and instant application startup accelerating launch speeds by over 3x (from ~4.5s down to ~1.2s) by eliminating artificial sleeps, optimizing GUI initialization, and deferring non-startup dependencies.
features: Interactive User Guide & Training Tutorial (F1): Comprehensive in-app guide and tutorial explaining the 3-step workflow, how to train the AI handwriting memory bank from proofreader corrections, managing multi-writer profiles, keyboard shortcuts, and offline features.
Dedicated Help Toolbar Button (❓): One-click access to the user guide and training walkthrough directly from the top action toolbar.
Lightning-Fast Application Startup (3x Speedup): Removed artificial startup sleeps and streamlined window initialization so Ohr HaKsav opens instantly in ~1.2 seconds instead of 4.5+ seconds.
Deferred Heavy Modules: Lazy-loaded document export and secondary dialog modules to ensure zero startup overhead.
Embedded Windows PE File Version Resource: All executables embed official Windows File Version (1.3.4.0), Product Version, and Company metadata visible in File Explorer Properties > Details.
Version-Labeled Installer Executable: Setup wizard is packaged as OhrHaKsav_Setup_v1.3.4.exe for clear version identification.

Pre-Flight Internet Connection Verification: Non-blocking socket verification on port 53 avoids network timeouts and provides helpful, offline-friendly guidance when running on isolated school/Yeshiva servers.
Silent Startup Background Update Check: Automatically and quietly checks for updates in the background on launch (configurable in Settings, default ON).

In-App Top Notification Banner: Displays a sleek, non-intrusive notification banner across the top of the main window when a new release is detected, featuring instant [Install Update Now], [What's New], and [Dismiss] controls.
Enhanced Offline & Network Domain Mode: Full support for local file paths and Windows Server domain UNC shares (e.g. \\newltcserver\Installs\OhrHaKsav).
Comprehensive Bilingual Localization: Both English and Hebrew interfaces are fully synchronized across Light and Dark themes.
